issues.description: The expected return type for getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor is inconsistent: the UML in the problem statement declares getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): int, whereas the template comment and the solution implementation indicate a double return type for more precise calculation. This mismatch can confuse students about which return type to implement and may cause test or compilation issues.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the return type specification consistent across all artifacts. Either: (a) update the UML in the problem statement to declare getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor(): double to match the template comment and solution, or (b) change the template comment and solution to use int and document the rounding behavior. Prefer option (a) to preserve the intent for a precise (double) calculation.
